name: Store camera credentials securely (optional)
title: Store camera credentials securely (optional)
description:
Only a System Manager should do this step. Open the camera and use the restricted Access Credentials tab: store username/password/secondary secret only in the protected permlevel-1 fields, which Frappe encrypts and hides from every other role. Use a non-secret label, rotate and record the rotation date, and keep notes free of passwords, tokens, and keys.

Never paste credentials into a camera description, event, screenshot, CSV, ticket, or onboarding note. Verify that access is limited to authorized System Managers and that backups/logs follow your secret-handling policy. Skip this optional step if the integration does not need stored credentials.
